subtitle: Sovereign Intelligence — Character & Equipment Research
changes: Added Character Intelligence to Live Armory, using existing sanitized Blizzard-returned character and equipment data without new network requests.
Displays returned equipped-record counts, item-level data coverage, returned item-level ranges, and the Blizzard-reported average character item level, clearly distinguishing missing fields.
Enables sorting by equipment slot or returned item level, with direct inspect-item handoff to the existing verified Item Codex.
Avoids simulated DPS, best-in-slot predictions, unverifiable account ownership, and automatic build recommendations.
Preserved all original Talent Forge planning, signed-in features, saved data, music, studio archive and working Discord release infrastructure.
